pairs.target: dùhéng méiyǒu zài wǎnghòu ràng .
pairs.english: Du Heng yielded no further ground.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡没有再往后让。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī nuó dào shí biān , qián xū tiēzhe dùn miàn sǎoguòqù , yúxià jǐtiáo tuǐ yìqí chēngzhù , měngdì wǎng shàng yìdǐng .
pairs.english: The creature edged to the stone, its front feelers sweeping against the shield's face; the remaining legs braced together, then heaved sharply upward.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西挪到石边，前须贴着盾面扫过去，余下几条腿一齐撑住，猛地往上一顶。

pairs.target: dùn tái le bàncùn , dùhéng de hòujiǎo què hái cǎi zài yuánchù .
pairs.english: The shield rose half an inch, but Du Heng's rear foot stayed planted.
pairs.hanzi: 盾抬了半寸，杜衡的后脚却还踩在原处。

pairs.target: wēn shù shēnchū de shǒu tíng zài tā jiān hòu , zhǐjiān wēiwēi fādǒu .
pairs.english: Wen Shu's outstretched hand hovered behind his shoulder, its fingertips trembling slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 温述伸出的手停在他肩后，指尖微微发抖。

pairs.target: " piān yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “A little to the side,”
pairs.hanzi: “偏一点。”

pairs.target: qī lán shuō .
pairs.english: Qi Lan said.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚说。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu xiàng zuǒcè kuà kāi .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou stepped out to the left.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟向左侧跨开。

pairs.target: dùhéng suíjí zhuǎn le dùn , jiāng nà kē dī fú de tóu jǐxiàng lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Du Heng immediately turned the shield, squeezing the low head the other way.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡随即转了盾，将那颗低伏的头挤向另一边。

pairs.target: yìngké hé dùn yán guā zài yìqǐ , xiǎng dé lín zhào yágēn fāsuān ; nàtiáo ruǎn bái de fèng yòu lù le chūlái , zhè yìhuí , méi zài huàng huíqù .
pairs.english: The hard shell and the shield rim scraped together, making Lin Zhao's teeth ache; the soft white seam showed again, and this time it didn't rock back out of sight.
pairs.hanzi: 硬壳和盾沿刮在一起，响得林照牙根发酸；那条软白的缝又露了出来，这一回，没再晃回去。

pairs.target: qī lán sōngkāi gōngxián , jiàn shèjìn nàtiáo fèng , zhī shèng bànjié jiàngān lù zài wàitou .
pairs.english: Qi Lan loosed the string; the arrow shot into the seam, leaving only half its shaft exposed.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚松开弓弦，箭射进那条缝，只剩半截箭杆露在外头。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī de shēnzi zhòurán xiàngshàng yì gōng , shěn yàn zhōu yǐ tiē dào dùn páng .
pairs.english: The creature's body abruptly arched upward; Shen Yanzhou had already closed in beside the shield.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西的身子骤然向上一弓，沈砚舟已贴到盾旁。

pairs.target: tā de jiàn bèi yìtiáo tuǐ dǎngzhù , rèn guāng hūrán duǎn le yíduàn , suíhòu cóng ké dǐ tiāochūlái , dài chū yípiàn hēihóng .
pairs.english: His sword was blocked by a leg; the blade's gleam suddenly shortened, then emerged from beneath the shell, trailing a streak of black-red.
pairs.hanzi: 他的剑被一条腿挡住，刃光忽然短了一段，随后从壳底挑出来，带出一片黑红。

pairs.target: jǐtiáo tuǐ luàn huàzhe tuì kāi , fù xià zhuàng shàng shí biān , zhěngfù yìngké biàn wāi le .
pairs.english: Its legs thrashed as it backed away; its belly struck the stone edge, and the whole carapace tilted.
pairs.hanzi: 几条腿乱划着退开，腹下撞上石边，整副硬壳便歪了。

pairs.target: dùhéng méiyǒu zhuī .
pairs.english: Du Heng didn't pursue.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡没有追。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu yě tuì le huílái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou retreated too.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟也退了回来。

pairs.target: shuǐ hái zài cháo dī gǒng liú .
pairs.english: Water was still flowing toward the low arch.
pairs.hanzi: 水还在朝低拱流。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī yòu chēng le yíxià , qiánduān táiqǐ , xì xū zài shuǐmiàn shàng chōudòng .
pairs.english: The creature braced once more, lifting its front end; the slender feelers twitched at the surface.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西又撑了一下，前端抬起，细须在水面上抽动。

pairs.target: lín zhào zuàn jǐn le xī shàng de bùliào , děng tā zài lái , bèi ké què mànmàn fúxiàqù , tiēzhù shítou , zài méi táiqǐ lái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao gripped the cloth over her knees, waiting for it to come again, but the back shell slowly settled against the stone and never rose again.
pairs.hanzi: 林照攥紧了膝上的布料，等它再来，背壳却慢慢伏下去，贴住石头，再没抬起来。

pairs.target: qī lán réng dā zhe jiàn .
pairs.english: Qi Lan still had an arrow nocked.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚仍搭着箭。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , shěn yàn zhōu cái diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Only after a while did Shen Yanzhou nod.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，沈砚舟才点头。

pairs.target: dùhéng yòng dùn yán bō guò tā de tuǐ , rào dào duàn zhù páng , yòu chá le nà liǎngzhī xiǎo de .
pairs.english: Du Heng nudged its legs with the shield rim, went around the broken pillar and checked the two smaller ones too.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡用盾沿拨过它的腿，绕到断柱旁，又查了那两只小的。

pairs.target: nà liǎngfù xì tuǐ dōu méi zài dòng .
pairs.english: The two sets of thin legs never moved again.
pairs.hanzi: 那两副细腿都没再动。

pairs.target: méi rén shuōhuà , zhǐyǒu tā cǎishuǐ shí fāchū de xiǎngshēng .
pairs.english: Nobody spoke; there was only the sound of him wading.
pairs.hanzi: 没人说话，只有他踩水时发出的响声。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhè cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ zuǐlǐ gān dé fā kǔ .
pairs.english: Only then did Lin Zhao notice how dry and bitter her mouth was.
pairs.hanzi: 林照这才发现，自己嘴里干得发苦。

pairs.target: " xiān huílái . "
pairs.english: “Come back first,”
pairs.hanzi: “先回来。”

pairs.target: shào píng cháo tā shuō .
pairs.english: Shao Ping said to her.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平朝她说。

pairs.target: tā jiāng diào zhe de suìshí mànmàn shōu shàng shí yán , kòuzhù huálún shéng .
pairs.english: He slowly hauled the hanging stone up onto the ledge and secured the pulley rope.
pairs.hanzi: 他将吊着的碎石慢慢收上石沿，扣住滑轮绳。

pairs.target: lín zhào yòng gōu bǐng bǎ shítou bō dào kàoqiáng chù , děng tā fàngwěn , cái jiě xià gōu , hé huálún yìqǐ bào zài méi shāng de nà zhī bìwān lǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao used the hook handle to nudge the stone against the wall; only when it was stable did she unclip the hook and cradle it with the pulley in her unhurt arm.
pairs.hanzi: 林照用钩柄把石头拨到靠墙处，等它放稳，才解下钩，和滑轮一起抱在没伤的那只臂弯里。

pairs.target: tā de jiǎo réng yǒuxiē dǒu , yánzhe láishí nà bànbiān gān shí nuó huíqù , shào píng shōu zhe yāo shéng ,
pairs.english: Her feet still shook a little; she edged back over the strip of dry stone she had used on the way out, while Shao Ping took in the waist rope.
pairs.hanzi: 她的脚仍有些抖，沿着来时那半边干石挪回去，邵平收着腰绳，

pairs.target: yìzhí děng tā zhàn dào zhuàntái lǐmiàn , cái tì tā jiěkāi .
pairs.english: He waited until she stood inside the landing before untying it for her.
pairs.hanzi: 一直等她站到转台里面，才替她解开。

pairs.target: shéngzi yì sōng , tā cái juéde lèi xià lè dé téng .
pairs.english: Only when the rope loosened did she feel the pain from its pressure under her ribs.
pairs.hanzi: 绳子一松，她才觉得肋下勒得疼。

pairs.target: wēn shù yǐjīng jiè shéng shànglái , cóng yàobāo lǐ qǔ le shuǐ hé bù .
pairs.english: Wen Shu had already climbed up using the rope, and took water and cloth from the medical bag.
pairs.hanzi: 温述已经借绳上来，从药包里取了水和布。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā shēnshǒu , lín zhào gāng tānkāi zhǎngxīn , yòu suō le yíxià .
pairs.english: He asked her to hold out her hand; Lin Zhao had barely opened her palm before flinching back.
pairs.hanzi: 他让她伸手，林照刚摊开掌心，又缩了一下。

pairs.target: " lǐtou yǒu shā . "
pairs.english: “There's grit inside,”
pairs.hanzi: “里头有砂。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: he said.
pairs.hanzi: 他说。

pairs.target: tā biàn bǎshǒu chóngxīn shēnchū qù .
pairs.english: So she held her hand out again.
pairs.hanzi: 她便把手重新伸出去。

pairs.target: shuǐ bǎ ní chōngkāi , shāngchù báobáodì hóng le yípiàn .
pairs.english: The water washed the mud away, leaving a thin red patch over the scrape.
pairs.hanzi: 水把泥冲开，伤处薄薄地红了一片。

pairs.target: wēn shù dītóu xǐjìng , diàn shàng gānjìng xìbù , ràoguò shǒu bèibāo hǎo , jiào tā shì zhe qū zhǐ .
pairs.english: Wen Shu bent his head and cleaned it, laid clean fine cloth over it, then wrapped it around her hand and asked her to try bending her fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 温述低头洗净，垫上干净细布，绕过手背包好，叫她试着曲指。

pairs.target: tā mànmàn wò dào yíbàn , téng dé tíngzhù .
pairs.english: She slowly closed her hand halfway, then stopped from the pain.
pairs.hanzi: 她慢慢握到一半，疼得停住。

pairs.target: " zhè zhī shǒu xiān bié zhuā shéng .
pairs.english: “Don't grip rope with this hand yet.
pairs.hanzi: “这只手先别抓绳。

pairs.target: yě bié zìjǐ chāi le . "
pairs.english: And don't take the dressing off yourself.”
pairs.hanzi: 也别自己拆了。”

pairs.target: lín zhào diǎntóu , zhǎngxīn què hái cháo shàng tuō zhe , bùzhī wǎng nǎér fàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao nodded, but still held her palm facing up, unsure where to put it.
pairs.hanzi: 林照点头，掌心却还朝上托着，不知往哪儿放。

pairs.target: xǔ cén bǎ xiàmiàn de shéng shōuhuí yíduàn , nuóchū dìfāng .
pairs.english: Xu Cen drew in a length of the rope below to make room.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑把下面的绳收回一段，挪出地方。

pairs.target: dùhéng shànglái hòu , xiān jiāng dùn kàoqiáng , shēnshǒu qù lā jiāndài , mǔzhǐ quèméinéng yíxià àn kāi kòuzǐ .
pairs.english: After coming up, Du Heng first leaned the shield against the wall, then reached to pull at his shoulder strap, but his thumb couldn't open the buckle at the first try.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡上来后，先将盾靠墙，伸手去拉肩带，拇指却没能一下按开扣子。

pairs.target: wēn shù kàn le tā yìyǎn , tā biàn bǎshǒu fàngxià le .
pairs.english: Wen Shu looked at him briefly, and he lowered his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 温述看了他一眼，他便把手放下了。

pairs.target: " huǎn yíhuìer . "
pairs.english: “Rest a moment,”
pairs.hanzi: “缓一会儿。”

pairs.target: wēn shùshuō .
pairs.english: Wen Shu said.
pairs.hanzi: 温述说。

pairs.target: shào píng jiāng huálún fàngdào bèi jià páng .
pairs.english: Shao Ping set the pulley beside the pack frame.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平将滑轮放到背架旁。

pairs.target: nà fù bèi jià hái píngtǎngzhe , kōngxiàlái de mù yǎnlǐ sāi zhe yìdiǎn shī ní .
pairs.english: The frame still lay flat, a little wet mud lodged in the empty mortise.
pairs.hanzi: 那副背架还平躺着，空下来的木眼里塞着一点湿泥。

pairs.target: lín zhào dīng zhe kàn le piànkè , xiǎngqǐ nàgēn héngmù zuānjìn gǒng xià de yàngzi .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao stared for a moment, remembering how the crossbar had disappeared beneath the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 林照盯着看了片刻，想起那根横木钻进拱下的样子。

pairs.target: " zhǎo gēn tì de jiùshì . "
pairs.english: “We'll just find a replacement,”
pairs.hanzi: “找根替的就是。”

pairs.target: shào píng shuō , " rén méi gēnzhe xiàqù jiù xíng . "
pairs.english: Shao Ping said. “As long as you didn't go down with it.”
pairs.hanzi: 邵平说，“人没跟着下去就行。”

pairs.target: tā xiǎng xiào , zuǐjiǎo dòngledòng , yòu dītóu kàn shǒu .
pairs.english: She tried to smile, but only the corners of her mouth moved before she looked down at her hand again.
pairs.hanzi: 她想笑，嘴角动了动，又低头看手。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu yǔ qī lán suíhòu shànglái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou and Qi Lan came up afterward.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟与戚岚随后上来。

pairs.target: tā shǒulǐ dài zhe jǐzhī báhuí de jiàn , duàndiào de bànjié dāndú jiá zhe , méi wǎng jiàn náng lǐ fàng .
pairs.english: She carried several retrieved arrows in her hand, holding the broken half separately rather than putting it in the quiver.
pairs.hanzi: 她手里带着几支拔回的箭，断掉的半截单独夹着，没往箭囊里放。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jiàn shàng de shuǐ shuǎi qù , wèn shào píng : " bǎn dǐxià kǎzhù le ? "
pairs.english: He flicked the water from his sword and asked Shao Ping, “Something wedged beneath the slab?”
pairs.hanzi: 他把剑上的水甩去，问邵平：“板底下卡住了？”

pairs.target: " kǎ le xiǎoshítou . "
pairs.english: “A little stone was wedged in there.”
pairs.hanzi: “卡了小石头。”

pairs.target: shào píng zhǐxiàng lín zhào , " tā xiān kànjiàn bù zǒushuǐ , guòqù huàn le gè tào fǎ .
pairs.english: Shao Ping pointed toward Lin Zhao. “She first noticed the water wasn't getting through, went over and changed the sling arrangement.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平指向林照，“她先看见不走水，过去换了个套法。

pairs.target: bǎn dǎo shì zìjǐ jiào shuǐ dǐng kāi de . "
pairs.english: The slab itself was pushed open by the water, though.”
pairs.hanzi: 板倒是自己叫水顶开的。”

pairs.target: " lúnzǐ shì shào shīfu shōu de . "
pairs.english: “It was Master Shao who worked the pulley,”
pairs.hanzi: “轮子是邵师傅收的。”

pairs.target: lín zhàoshuō .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao said.
pairs.hanzi: 林照说。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu kàn le kàn tā bāo hǎo de shǒu , yòu kàn xiàng nà fù shǎo le héngmù de bèi jià .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou looked at her bandaged hand, then looked toward the frame that was missing its crossbar.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟看了看她包好的手，又看向那副少了横木的背架。

pairs.target: " huíqù gēn fāng guǎnshì shuō , zhè yíduàn zhàoshí jì , liǎnggè rén dōu jì .
pairs.english: “When we get back, tell Steward Fang to record this part as it happened and include you both.
pairs.hanzi: “回去跟方管事说，这一段照实记，两个人都记。

pairs.target: jiàn bǎo lǐ yě xiě shàng . "
pairs.english: Put it in the references too.”
pairs.hanzi: 荐保里也写上。”

pairs.target: lín zhào táiqǐ tóu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked up.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抬起头。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng zhuǎnshēn qù wèn xǔ cén jiēxià de qíngkuàng , tā nà shēng yìngdá biàn qīng le xiē , luò zài shuǐshēng lǐ , yě bù zhīdào tā tīngjiàn méiyǒu .
pairs.english: He had already turned to ask Xu Cen about the steps below; her reply came more softly, lost in the sound of water, and she didn't know whether he had heard.
pairs.hanzi: 他已经转身去问许岑阶下的情况，她那声应答便轻了些，落在水声里，也不知道他听见没有。

pairs.target: yòu xiē le yízhèn , dùhéng shì zhe huódòng guò shǒuzhǐ , cái chóngxīn wǎn dùn .
pairs.english: After another rest, Du Heng tried moving his fingers before taking up his shield again.
pairs.hanzi: 又歇了一阵，杜衡试着活动过手指，才重新挽盾。

pairs.target: qī lán tiāo guò bá xià de jiàn , bǎ wánzhěng de shōuhuí náng lǐ , duàn de fàngzài bèi jià páng , yòu chóngxīn dā shàng yìzhī .
pairs.english: Qi Lan sorted the retrieved arrows, returned the intact ones to her quiver, set the broken one beside the frame, then she nocked an arrow again.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚挑过拔下的箭，把完整的收回囊里，断的放在背架旁，又重新搭上一支。

pairs.target: tíngyuàn lǐ de shuǐ tuì dào jiǎohuái shàngxià , zuǒ qiáng pòkǒu háiyǒu xìliú , lùchū de shítou shàngpù zhe huángní .
pairs.english: The water in the courtyard had fallen to around ankle height; a trickle still ran from the left-wall breach, and yellow mud covered the exposed stones.
pairs.hanzi: 庭院里的水退到脚踝上下，左墙破口还有细流，露出的石头上铺着黄泥。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu hé dùhéng xiān xiàqù , yánzhe fāngcái lì wěn de nà pái shí biān zǒu le yíduàn .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou and Du Heng went down first and walked a stretch along the row of stone edges where they'd just held firm.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟和杜衡先下去，沿着方才立稳的那排石边走了一段。

pairs.target: xǔ cén kànguò mùxiá lǐ de zhēn , hé shàng gài , cháo hòu zhāoshǒu .
pairs.english: Xu Cen checked the needle in the wooden case, shut the lid and beckoned to those behind.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑看过木匣里的针，合上盖，朝后招手。

pairs.target: " cǎi shí shàng .
pairs.english: “Step on the stones.
pairs.hanzi: “踩石上。

pairs.target: yòubiān ní lǐ bié luòjiǎo . "
pairs.english: Don't step in the mud on the right.”
pairs.hanzi: 右边泥里别落脚。”

pairs.target: shào píng liúzài zhuàntái zhěnglǐ shéng jù , lín zhào kōng zhuóshǒu xiàqù .
pairs.english: Shao Ping stayed on the landing to sort the rope gear; Lin Zhao went down empty-handed.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平留在转台整理绳具，林照空着手下去。

pairs.target: sōngdòng de nà yījí , tā méi gǎn cǎi , fú zhe wēn shù de shǒu , cóng pángbiān hái lián zhe de shí miàn cè guòqù .
pairs.english: She didn't dare tread the loosened step; supported by Wen Shu's hand, she edged across the stone still joined at its side.
pairs.hanzi: 松动的那一级，她没敢踩，扶着温述的手，从旁边还连着的石面侧过去。

pairs.target: dào le shuǐbiān , tā cái kànqīng nà fù yìngké jiūjìng yǒu duō dà , ké miànshàng hái liú zhe jiàn cā guò de bái hén .
pairs.english: Only at the water's edge could she see just how big the shell was; the white scrape from the arrow was still there.
pairs.hanzi: 到了水边，她才看清那副硬壳究竟有多大，壳面上还留着箭擦过的白痕。

pairs.target: tā ràokāi le , méiyǒu zài kàn dǐxià .
pairs.english: She went around it without looking underneath again.
pairs.hanzi: 她绕开了，没有再看底下。

pairs.target: duàn gǒng hòutou bǐ zhuàn táishàng kànzhe gèngshēn .
pairs.english: Behind the broken arch, it was deeper than it had looked from the landing.
pairs.hanzi: 断拱后头比转台上看着更深。

pairs.target: cū téng cóng shífèng lǐ chuíxiàlái , jǐpiàn yèzi zhē zhe nà yìdiǎn guāng .
pairs.english: Thick vines hung from the stone cracks, a few leaves screening the speck of light.
pairs.hanzi: 粗藤从石缝里垂下来，几片叶子遮着那一点光。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu yòng jiàn bōkāi téng ,
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou swept the vines aside with his sword;
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟用剑拨开藤，

pairs.target: lín zhào kànjiàn báixiàn shōu zài yídào lièkǒu zhōng , lí dì zhǐyǒu xītóu gāo ,
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw white threads gathered inside a fissure only knee-high above the ground;
pairs.hanzi: 林照看见白线收在一道裂口中，离地只有膝头高，

pairs.target: sìzhōu de shítou què réng huīpūpū de , fǎngfú gēnběn méi bèi zhàoliàng .
pairs.english: yet the surrounding stone stayed drab gray, as if it weren't lit at all.
pairs.hanzi: 四周的石头却仍灰扑扑的，仿佛根本没被照亮。

pairs.target: tā xiàyìshí tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: She stopped without thinking.
pairs.hanzi: 她下意识停住了。

pairs.target: gé zhe yí bì yuǎn , nàxiē xiàn xiàng hái zài wǎng tā yǎnqián shōu .
pairs.english: An arm's length away, the threads seemed to keep drawing inward before her eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 隔着一臂远，那些线像还在往她眼前收。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng zhǎodào zuì lǐtou nà yìdiǎn , yǎnjīng què gēnbúshàng , kàndào de měi yìgēn dōu xiàng zài tóngyígè dìfāng zhéhuíqù .
pairs.english: She tried to find the innermost point, but her eyes couldn't keep up; every thread she saw seemed to fold back at the same place.
pairs.hanzi: 她想找到最里头那一点，眼睛却跟不上，看到的每一根都像在同一个地方折回去。

pairs.target: " tuì liǎngbù . "
pairs.english: “Two steps back,”
pairs.hanzi: “退两步。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu shuō .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou said.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟说。

pairs.target: wēn shù dài tā wǎnghòu nuó , dùhéng shǒuzhù cèmiàn .
pairs.english: Wen Shu helped her move back while Du Heng guarded the flank.
pairs.hanzi: 温述带她往后挪，杜衡守住侧面。

pairs.target: xǔ cén xiānkāi mùxiá de gài , qī lán jiāng shǒulǐ nà zhījiàn fàng dī le xiē .
pairs.english: Xu Cen lifted the lid of the case, and Qi Lan lowered the arrow in her hand a little.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑掀开木匣的盖，戚岚将手里那支箭放低了些。

pairs.target: jiànjiān shēn le jìnqù .
pairs.english: The sword tip went in.
pairs.hanzi: 剑尖伸了进去。

pairs.target: báixiàn hūrán bēngzhí .
pairs.english: The white threads suddenly drew taut.
pairs.hanzi: 白线忽然绷直。

pairs.target: lín zhào jiān bèi gēnzhe jǐn le yíxià , cái fāxiànzìjǐ yě píngzhù le qì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao's shoulders and back tightened with them for an instant, and only then did she realize she was holding her breath too.
pairs.hanzi: 林照肩背跟着紧了一下，才发现自己也屏住了气。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu de shǒuwàn wǎng xià yì chén , jiàn méiyǒu lìkè chuān guòqù , rèn biān zhī liàng qǐ yìtiáo jí xì de bái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou's wrist dipped down; the sword didn't pass through at once, and only a hairline of white glowed along its edge.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟的手腕往下一沉，剑没有立刻穿过去，刃边只亮起一条极细的白。

pairs.target: jiēzhe , nà yìdiǎn guāng wǎng nèi suō le .
pairs.english: Then the speck of light contracted inward.
pairs.hanzi: 接着，那一点光往内缩了。

pairs.target: lín zhào méi tīngjiàn shénme duànliè shēng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao didn't hear any snapping sound.
pairs.hanzi: 林照没听见什么断裂声。

pairs.target: tā zhī jué ěrbiān xiàng sōngkāi le yìcéng , yuánxiān jǐ zài yìqǐ de dīshuǐ shēng , hūrán fēnchū le yuǎnjìn .
pairs.english: She only felt as though something had loosened around her ears; the sounds of dripping, once crowded together, suddenly separated into near and far.
pairs.hanzi: 她只觉耳边像松开了一层，原先挤在一起的滴水声，忽然分出了远近。

pairs.target: jiàn cóng shífèng qián chuíxiàlái , jiān shàng kōngkōng de , bìng méiyǒu tiāochū tā yǐwéi huì yǒu de jīngshí .
pairs.english: The sword lowered before the fissure, its tip empty; it hadn't brought out the crystal she had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 剑从石缝前垂下来，尖上空空的，并没有挑出她以为会有的晶石。

pairs.target: xǔ cén dītóu kàn zhēn .
pairs.english: Xu Cen looked down at the needle.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑低头看针。

pairs.target: xì zhēn mànmàn tuìhuíqù , hái zài qīng chàn .
pairs.english: The fine needle slowly retreated, still quivering.
pairs.hanzi: 细针慢慢退回去，还在轻颤。

pairs.target: tā děng le piànkè , cái jiāng xiá gài qīngqīng hé shàng .
pairs.english: She waited a moment before gently closing the lid.
pairs.hanzi: 她等了片刻，才将匣盖轻轻合上。

pairs.target: " kāi le . "
pairs.english: “It's undone.”
pairs.hanzi: “开了。”

pairs.target: lín zhào yòu wǎng lièkǒu lǐ wàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked into the fissure again.
pairs.hanzi: 林照又往裂口里望。

pairs.target: nàlǐ zhī shèng yípiàn shī hēi , tā děng zhe nàgēn xìxiàn zài wǎng lǐ shōu yícì , zhàn le xǔjiǔ , què méiyǒu zài liàng qǐlái .
pairs.english: Only a patch of wet darkness remained there; she waited for the fine thread to draw inward once more, but stood a long time without another glimmer.
pairs.hanzi: 那里只剩一片湿黑，她等着那根细线再往里收一次，站了许久，却没有再亮起来。
